author: Seung Wook
problem: There are N programmers numbered 1 to N and M facts saying programmer A is stronger than programmer B; strength is a consistent total order. Print the number of the strongest programmer if the facts determine them uniquely, otherwise -1.
bug_description: Prints the 0-based list index of the strongest programmer instead of their 1-based number.

comments.accurate: Prints the number of the only programmer nobody beats, or -1 if that is not unique
comments.wrong_behavior: Prints the list index of the only programmer nobody beats, or -1 if there isn't exactly one
comments.wrong_location: Output verified; check the M input lines, where A and B could be swapped when marking who was beaten
